segments.name: Argentina
segments.description: Operates airports in Argentina under concession agreements, serving airlines, passengers and cargo users.
segments.evidence: As of and for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, we have identified six reportable segments: Argentina, Italy, Brazil, Uruguay, Ecuador and Armenia.

segments.name: Ecuador
segments.description: Operates airports in Ecuador under concession agreements, including TAGSA and the Galapagos airport via associate ECOGAL.
segments.evidence: Revenue and expense information on a per segment basis for Ecuador includes the results of TAGSA but does not include the results of ECOGAL.

segments.name: Armenia
segments.description: Operates airports in Armenia, including Zvartnots International Airport, under concession agreements.
segments.evidence: In Armenia, we submitted to the Armenian Government a new master plan including a capital investment program of U.S.$425 million to be executed by 2033, covering infrastructure development, operational enhancements, and long-term capacity at Zvartnots International Airport.

revenueModel.text: The company earns fees from airlines and passengers for aeronautical services such as landing, transit, passenger, parking and security fees, under concession agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: These fees are invoiced to users of our airport infrastructure, principally airlines using our airports, either from their general revenue or as collected directly from airline passengers.
